items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with the required labels; p300 on the right with the 300 uL tip rack in slot 11, which suits the 100 uL volumes.
Log line 2 aspirates 220 uL from reservoir A1 (distribute adds a 20 uL disposal volume), not the 200 uL the task specifies, though the plate A1 and B1 dispenses are 100 uL each.
Log shows pick up tip first, then aspirate and dispenses, then drop tip at the end.
220 uL aspirate is within the p300 range, apiLevel 2.15 is valid, and the simulation passed.
The single transfer of 100 uL from reservoir A1 to plate A1 and B1 is done; the extra 20 uL is only a disposal volume and does not change the plate contents.

judge.summary: The protocol puts 100 uL into each of plate A1 and B1 using the p300 with a single tip, which is dropped at the end. However, distribute() aspirates 220 uL instead of 200 uL from the reservoir, so the volumes_and_wells item fails.
